profile.headline: Software Engineer at Options Xchange Group
profile.summary: I am a DevOps jack of all trades. I have built and supported infrastructure for a wide variety of 3rd party and in-house services for large-scale production environments, and developed IAC + CI/CD processes for each. I pride myself on tackling difficult problems while being open about limitations and failures. Always learning!

positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description:
•	Led and coordinated group of 5 other computer science seniors using modern team software development practices
•	Developed natural language processing software to scrape data from financial info & disclosures of large companies
•	Created algorithms to analyze and predict financial trends based on gathered structural data
•	Collaborated with PhD. students in the Leeds School of Business to assist with their doctoral research
•	Deployed software online after functional for use by other researchers

company.name: University of Colorado CS Senior Projects Course
